title: Monorepo Root Compose Repo Folder
description: repo cli: The .repo folder should be only created once at the monoreporoot. Regardless if for caching, testing, etc
summary: Fixed remaining root leak: findRepoRoot now prefers monorepo marker (repo/cli/main.go) over local go.mod roots, ensuring cache/meta paths resolve to monorepo root. Added tests for monorepo marker resolution and cache dir anchoring.
